description: This file defines the base class 'KeysBase' in the PdfSharp library, which is used for managing dictionary keys within the PDF processing context. It includes methods to create metadata for dictionary keys with different default types.

classes.name: KeysBase
classes.description: Base class for all dictionary Keys classes used in PDF processing within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: CreateMeta
methods.description: Creates a DictionaryMeta instance for the specified type, used for managing PDF dictionary keys, with optional default content key and content types.

methods.name: CreateMeta
methods.description: Creates a DictionaryMeta with specified default key and content types for handling missing keys during value retrieval.
